summary: Retested RibhShare first-signin flows (1..4) after AuthGuard fix in /app/app/_layout.tsx. FLOW 1 (invalid code) and FLOW 4 (re-redemption) PASS with correct inline errors. FLOW 2 (happy path) FAILS: the AuthGuard race is NOT fully resolved. The current fix only whitelists segments[1]==='set-password', but the guard fires WHILE the user is still on /first-signin (segments[1]==='first-signin'), the moment verifyOtp creates a session. The guard falls through to router.replace(getDefaultTabRoute(role)) BEFORE FirstSigninScreen has a chance to router.replace('/set-password?projectId=...'). Observed navigation chain: /first-signin -> /projects -> /home (investor role). FLOW 3 (sign in with new password) fails downstream because Flow 2 never sets the password (400 Invalid login credentials).

integration_issues.issue: AuthGuard race still present. FirstSigninScreen.handleSubmit runs verifyMagicToken which calls setSession -> AuthGuard useEffect re-runs while user is STILL on /first-signin. allowedAuthedAuthRoute checks segments[1]==='set-password' but at that instant segments[1]==='first-signin', so guard fires router.replace(getDefaultTabRoute(role)) and beats FirstSigninScreen's router.replace('/set-password?projectId=...'). Result: user lands on /home (investor) and /set-password never mounts, password is never set.

action_items: Extend AuthGuard whitelist to include /first-signin too. Minimal diff in /app/app/_layout.tsx line 28: `const allowedAuthedAuthRoute = segments[1] === 'set-password' || segments[1] === 'first-signin';` This lets FirstSigninScreen keep its momentary session-bearing state on /first-signin long enough to router.replace to /set-password.

BETTER FIX (recommended): Add a `mustSetPassword: boolean` flag to useAuthStore. Set it in FirstSigninScreen BEFORE verifyMagicToken (right after successful redeemInviteCode when passwordAlreadySet===false). In AuthGuard, short-circuit: `if (mustSetPassword) return;` — this decouples the race entirely from route segments. Clear the flag in setPasswordAndMark on success.
After the fix is applied, re-run the helper flow to mint a fresh code (previous code AZAFR779 for ribhshare.e2e+r1784643164@gmail.com is now consumed) and rerun FLOW 2 + FLOW 3.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthGuard whitelist in _layout.tsx line 28 is too narrow — it only allows /set-password but the race also occurs while the user is on /first-signin. Either widen the whitelist or use a mustSetPassword flag decoupled from segments.

FirstSigninScreen.handleSubmit interleaves session mutation (verifyMagicToken -> setSession) with async fetchProfile before doing router.replace. Each intermediate setState triggers AuthGuard re-run. Consider setting a mustSetPassword flag BEFORE calling verifyMagicToken so the guard is inert during the transition.

setSession in useAuthStore also unconditionally sets user.role to 'INVESTOR' (line 30). This is a foot-gun: for a CEO / Line Manager signing in it briefly flips role in the store until fetchProfile completes. Not related to today's bug but should be revisited.

rca of the issue:
Reproduction (repeat of iter_8 with AuthGuard fix applied): (1) LM POST /functions/v1/send-invitation -> signinCode AZAFR779; (2) UI /first-signin submit -> redeem-invite-code returns passwordAlreadySet:false; (3) supabase.auth.verifyOtp({token_hash, type:'magiclink'}) succeeds -> setSession fires -> AuthGuard useEffect re-runs; (4) In AuthGuard, session=truthy, inAuthGroup=true, segments=['(auth)','first-signin'], so allowedAuthedAuthRoute = ('first-signin' === 'set-password') = FALSE; (5) Guard falls into `else if` branch and calls router.replace(getDefaultTabRoute(role)) - since role is momentarily null it goes to /projects, then role loads (investor) it goes to /home; (6) FirstSigninScreen's router.replace('/set-password?projectId=...') never wins because it runs AFTER the setSession/state-change re-render that already redirected. Observed navigation trace: /first-signin -> /projects -> /home. Mitigation - two options:

A) MINIMAL: broaden whitelist in _layout.tsx line 28:
```tsx
const allowedAuthedAuthRoute = segments[1] === 'set-password' || segments[1] === 'first-signin';
```

B) BETTER: mustSetPassword flag in useAuthStore. In FirstSigninScreen, right after successful redeemInviteCode and before verifyMagicToken:
```tsx
if (!redeem.passwordAlreadySet) useAuthStore.getState().setMustSetPassword(true);
```
And in AuthGuard:
```tsx
if (mustSetPassword) return; // let FirstSigninScreen/SetPasswordScreen own navigation
```
Clear the flag inside setPasswordAndMark on success.
